propositions: FixedBench's 35-65% over-action result lacks a criterion to determine whether proposed changes are actually needed
bug tickets currently short-circuit the plan-review gate to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive review (verified on bug 5886 with zero llm_calls)
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate need or reproduce current broken behavior
Bug tickets must receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of DET floor plus necessity probe instead of skipping review entirely
The necessity criterion must apply to bugs (no suppress_types restriction) and pass well-motivated no-ops, docs-only, and reproduction+motivation cases
Both necessity probe and bug review tier must integrate with existing advisory-criterion infrastructure (routing, registry, rubric, auto-monitoring) and never block
